svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two the same: one for the spreader, one for the cutter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 60 long x 130 wide x 92 tall, faces square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and parallel: the two 130 x 60 faces carry the frame plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore through on the long axis: 72 mm for the cylinder body.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From the front face, cut the cylinder's collar thread (71.4 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 UN class) 40 mm deep. Check the thread on the bought

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cylinder first and cut to match it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each 130 x 60 face: four M16 holes, drill 14 mm, tap 24 mm full

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thread, at 15 and 45 mm from the front face, 50 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screws onto the collar until the collar end is flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front face; the plates sit flat on the 130 x 60 faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plates lie flat with no rock; all eight screws start by hand.
